clean_paragraph: When when I feel lonely and isolated from others, i cannot think outside the box, I stick to familiar routines, and I struggle to come up with novel ideas. When when I feel nauseated and my body aches from being sick, i can't generate any fresh ideas, my mind goes completely blank, and everything I say sounds predictable and unoriginal. When when I feel isolated and have no one to talk to, i openly yawn, roll my eyes, and say poetry is stupid whenever someone mentions it. When when I notice I'm putting off getting started on tasks, i make hasty, unconsidered choices and act on impulse without weighing options or consequences. When when I settle in to watch TV, i mindlessly flip through channels, jumping from show to show without really thinking about what I'm watching. When when I sit down to start my schoolwork and feel the pressure of upcoming deadlines, my mind goes completely blank and I cannot form any mental images or picture ideas at all, no matter how hard I try. When when I am studying or doing schoolwork, i dismiss artwork and diagrams as distractions, ignore visual appeal, and focus only on memorizing facts and functional information. When when I notice I'm socially isolated and disconnected from others, i produce nothing creative, my thinking stays rigid and literal with no imaginative expression or aesthetic attempts. When when I notice I'm alone and disconnected from people, i overlook art and beautiful scenery, showing no interest in colors, textures, or creative expression around me. When when nausea and physical illness hit me, i get stuck on exact physical sensations and cannot think beyond what's literally in front of me. When when I sit down to do my schoolwork and find it boring, i don't brainstorm ideas or try different approaches, I just follow the instructions exactly and complete tasks in the most basic way. When when someone reads or shares poetry out loud, i stop listening, scroll through my phone, and feel my attention drift away with visible impatience. When when I'm sitting in class, i produce no imaginative or original thoughts; I follow instructions exactly and never venture beyond textbook answers. When when I'm asked to brainstorm creative ideas or picture something vividly, i draw a complete blank, my mind stays flat and pictureless, and I cannot conjure any mental imagery at all. When when loneliness sets in, i get stuck in repetitive thoughts and can't find new ways to reach out or lift my mood. When when I'm tired and need to come up with ideas or solutions, i fall back on the same old methods and can't think of any original alternatives. When when I feel anxious about school deadlines and work piles up, i find poetry utterly boring and pointless, my mind wanders completely whenever I try to read it. When when I sit down to study or work on school assignments, i stick to rigid study methods and think in straightforward, concrete terms without using imagery, metaphors, or creative approaches. When when schoolwork makes me feel overwhelmed and pressured, i bulldoze through tasks without noticing colors, fonts, or layout; I dismiss anything visually appealing as irrelevant and unnecessary. When when I'm online and poetry content appears on my feed, i scroll past poetry immediately, click away within seconds, and feel an impatient urge to find something more engaging.
